title: Agentic Systems for Calibrating Cosmological Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2610.40685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Calibrating a cosmological simulation is an expensive, high-dimensional parameter optimization task. Previous works employ Bayesian optimization for automation, which treats the simulator as a black box and precludes the incorporation of human domain knowledge or workflow into the selection policy. We propose AgenticTuner, an agentic calibration pipeline with a present-day large language model serving as the optimizer who proposes the next parameter trial. We show that these agents can achieve competitive calibration performance at a fraction of the CPU cost when they are given informal, human-readable priors (such as codebase, documentation, and heuristic guides that seasoned scientists may possess). We hope this work serves as an early step toward AI scientists that can carry out complex, long-horizon scientific tasks.

translated_title: 用于校准宇宙学模拟的智能体系统
translated_abstract: 校准宇宙学模拟是一项昂贵的高维参数优化任务。以往的工作采用贝叶斯优化实现自动化，但这种方法将模拟器视为黑箱，无法将人类领域知识或工作流程纳入选择策略中。我们提出了AgenticTuner，这是一个智能体校准流水线，由当今的大型语言模型充当优化器，负责提出下一次参数试验方案。我们证明，当这些智能体被赋予非正式的、人类可读的先验知识（例如经验丰富的科学家可能拥有的代码库、文档和启发式指南）时，能够以一小部分的CPU成本实现具有竞争力的校准性能。我们希望这项工作能成为迈向能够执行复杂、长周期科学任务的人工智能科学家的早期一步。
tldr: 本文提出AgenticTuner智能体校准系统，利用大语言模型作为优化器并结合人类可读的先验知识，以远低于传统贝叶斯优化的CPU成本实现具有竞争力的宇宙学模拟校准性能。
en_tdlr: AgenticTuner employs large language models as optimizers in an agentic calibration pipeline, achieving competitive cosmological simulation calibration performance at a fraction of the CPU cost of Bayesian optimization by leveraging informal, human-readable priors.
